meta.design: C0 4-lift twin-boom quadplane, v0.4.0 (CAD rev D)
meta.frame: Same as cad/params.txt: X forward, Y up, Z right. Joint coordinates in the md are local to each part (boom axis = local X, split plane = local y 0).
notes: Every head dimension is the maximum from the vendor product page (Bolt Depot 'Product details', checked 2026-10-21).
clearance_hole_mm is the ISO 273 normal (H13) value; the printed-part model value is clearance_hole_mm + 0.2 (FDM compensation, see fits FT07).
torque_Nm values marked EST in torque_basis are engineering estimates to be confirmed by measurement item M3 in the md.
qty is per aircraft; order_qty includes spares.
Entries with length_mm marked provisional depend on a part dimension not published (listed in 'unknowns').

fasteners.description: Motor to motor plate (4 lift + pusher), from below through the PA6-CF floor into the motor base

counterbore.note: opens from the boom bore up to the 4.5 mm floor (lift); from the cup interior (pusher)

fasteners.threadlocker: Loctite 242, one drop on the last 2-3 threads only; keep off the PA6-CF (TDS: not for thermoplastics)
fasteners.torque_basis: EST: limited by bearing pressure on the printed floor (F = T/(K d) = 0.6/(0.16 x 0.003) = 1250 N; 41 MPa on the washer). Fastenal A2-70 M3 lubricated max 0.81.
joints: J01 lift motor to motor plate (x4 motors, 4 each)
J12 pusher motor to cup (4)

fasteners.description: Split-clamp screws (motor mounts, tail clamps), stabiliser/fin shoe screws, provisional lift-prop screws

counterbore.note: clamp caps; none on fin shoe flange

fasteners.threadlocker: none (brass insert in plastic); witness mark
fasteners.torque_basis: EST: insert torque-out in PETG/PA6-CF not published; confirm >= 2x by coupon test M3
joints: J02 motor mount upper/lower clamp (4 per mount x4)
J08 tail clamp to rear stub (4 per side)
J09 fin shoe + stabiliser to tail clamp (2 per side)
J03 lift prop plate to motor hub (2 per motor, provisional)
J06 gear clamp halves on boom (4 per clamp x4)

fasteners.description: Boom splice cross-bolts (rear motor mount) and rear boom-clamp bolts to the wing hardpoint

counterbore.note: splice: head + washer; rear wing clamp: d 6.5, depth 7.5, no washer

fasteners.torque_basis: EST: clamp passes through a printed block and a crush plug; Fastenal A2-70 M3 lubricated max 0.81
joints: J04 boom splice at rear motor mount (2 per side)
J05b rear boom clamp to wing hardpoint (2 per side)

fasteners.description: Landing-leg retaining cross-bolt through gear clamp and leg

counterbore.note: 4.0 deep so the head and washer stay outside the leg tube (CAD rev B)

nut.note: pocket 4.3 deep: the nut bears just outside the leg tube; an 8.0 pocket would cut into the leg socket (CAD rev B)

joints: J07 landing leg in gear clamp socket (1 per leg)
fasteners.part_no: 6385 (M3 x 30 socket cap; number and price not verified, EST)
fasteners.cad_change: hardware-spec J07 gave M3 x 25 with an 8.0 nut pocket in the 34 mm block: the pocket would reach x -9, inside the leg tube (radius 12.7). With the nut outside the tube (bearing at -12.7) and the head seat at +13.0 the screw must be 30 long (CAD rev B, 2026-10-21).

joints: J05a front boom clamp to wing spar collar (2 per side)

fasteners.description: Light-duty screws into inserts: pusher cup radial screws, canopy hatch, pitot clamp, FC tray (provisional)
fasteners.standard: ISO 7380-1 button head (vendor lists no standard; dims match)
joints: J12 pusher cup to pod tail ring
J13 canopy hatch to pod frame
J16 pitot clamp
J15 FC to tray (provisional)

fasteners.note: extra 8 cover a shorter lift-prop screw if the measured hub is thin (see F02 provisional)
joints: J11 wing saddle root-plate flange to pod frame (4)

fasteners.description: Wing panel retention bolt (one per side, 70 % chord, through the saddle bolt pillar and the panel root tongue)
fasteners.standard: ISO 7380-1 button head (vendor lists no standard; dims match)
fasteners.torque_basis: EST: PETG pillar bearing (F = 1.0/(0.16 x 0.005) = 1250 N on 47 mm2 = 27 MPa)
joints: J10 wing panel to saddle (1 per side)
fasteners.cad_change: Wing_Bolt in BuildVtol.cs is M5 x 30; the section is 21.8 mm thick at 70 % chord (calc), so a 30 mm screw protrudes. Use 20 mm.

fasteners.description: Servo mounting screws (provisional: servo tab hole size and spacing not published)
fasteners.torque_basis: EST: snug against servo rubber grommets/tabs; no published value
joints: J14 servo to printed servo tray (4 per servo x5)

joints: J17 horn to aileron hardpoint (2 per horn x2)
J17 horn through elevator and rudders with kit backplate (2 per horn x3)

sources: hole 4.0 mm and length 5.7 mm: ruthex comparison table on https://www.amazon.com/dp/B08K1BVGN9 (checked 2026-10-21)
OD 4.6 mm, min wall 1.6 mm: https://3djake.com/ruthex/threaded-insert-m3-100-pieces (search snippet, 2026-10-21)
hole depth = length + >= 1.3 mm: EST rule, cf. JLC3DP M4x8 insert -> 10 mm hole, https://jlc3dp.com/help/article/threaded-insert-service

consumables.use: metal-to-metal threads only: F01 motor screws, F12 prop screws

fits.joint: Wing joiner 0.875 x 0.058 in in spar socket 1.000 x 0.058 in
fits.action: measure every tube on receipt (M1); if tight, lap the joiner with 400-grit; if > 0.30 mm, shim with one wrap of packing tape
fits.source: OD +-0.004 in, wall +-0.002 in (Zoro listing for 1.000 x 0.035 6061-T6 drawn tube, search 2026-10-21; same tolerance assumed for 0.875 and 0.058 wall, EST); ID tol = OD tol + 2 x wall tol (calc). Alcobra lists +-0.008 in for 5/8-1 in OD (https://alcobrametals.com/?p=91925): if that applies the band doubles. ASTM B210 table not accessed (—).

fits.joint: 1.000 in boom in printed split clamp bore (motor mounts, boom clamps, gear clamps, tail clamps)
fits.action: split halves stand 0.6 mm off the centreline each side; when the screws close the gap the bore clamps before the halves touch for any printed bore error < 1.0 mm
fits.source: boom OD tol as FT01; FDM bore tol +-0.2 mm (EST, well-tuned desktop FDM is +-0.1-0.3, Xometry desktop spec +-0.5 % lower limit +-0.5 mm, https://xometry.pro/en/articles/3d-printing-tolerances/)

fits.joint: Landing leg 1.000 x 0.058 in in gear clamp socket (blind, 14.0 deep)
fits.action: slip fit; ream or sand if tight; retained by F05 cross-bolt

fits.joint: Printed splice plug inside boom (rear motor mount), 80 mm long, 40 mm each tube
fits.action: plug carries the cross-bolt crush load and aligns the tubes; cross-bolts carry axial and torsional load
fits.source: boom ID 0.930 in (OnlineMetals pid 1211); tol from FT01 rule

fits.joint: Spar socket tube in hot-wired/drilled foam channel, bonded
fits.action: bond line filled with foam-safe adhesive (BOM line 'Foam-safe glue 4 oz')
fits.source: channel tolerance EST (hand hot-wire); tube tol as FT01

fits.joint: Joiner in wing saddle root-plate bores, slip fit (rev B)
fits.action: SLIP FIT, NOT BONDED (CAD rev B, 2026-10-21): the joiner slides out of the saddle so the pod transport piece stays inside the R4 0.5 m envelope; with both panels bolted on (F09) it is captured between two printed Joiner_Stop discs bonded in the spar sockets at 300 mm from the root faces. Lap the joiner or drill the bore to 22.6 if tight
fits.source: CAD bore = joinOD + 0.23 mm (cad/BuildVtol.cs WingSaddle); FDM tol EST; retention: cad/params.mjs Joiner_Stop

fits.joint: Screw clearance holes in printed parts
fits.action: print a hole coupon first (M2); motor-pattern holes: drill to 3.4 after printing
fits.source: ISO 273 H13 table (Albany County Fasteners chart, https://www.albanycountyfasteners.com/media/6b/b8/g0/1764944339/clearance-hole-chart.pdf); +0.2 mm compensation: https://pollen.am/design_for_3d_printing_holes

fits.joint: ruthex M3 heat-set insert in printed hole
fits.action: interference is intended (melt-in); tune the modelled hole on the coupon so the as-printed hole is 4.0

fits.joint: Lift prop 4 mm centre hole on X4110S shaft (dia 4, 0/-0.03)
fits.action: prop hole tolerance not published (—); must slide on by hand

fits.joint: APC 14x8.5EP 6.35 mm bore on 6 mm adapter shaft (dia 6, 0/-0.03)

hole.note: use the APC adapter ring that fits 6 mm; ring sizes not published (—)

fits.action: fit ring, check the prop runs true by spinning by hand
fits.source: Motion RC LP14085EP listing (search 2026-10-21); SunnySky drawing

fits.joint: Pusher motor cup in pod tail ring
fits.action: 4 radial F07 screws locate and retain
fits.source: pod tail dia 60 mm (cad/params.txt tailR 0.030) less 2.0 mm wall (EST)

printed_parts_default.rule: +-0.5 % of size, lower limit +-0.5 mm (desktop FDM)

printed_parts_controlled.motor_pattern_position_mm: dia 0.2 to the motor pilot (fixed-fastener rule T = (H - F)/2 with H 3.4, F 3.0)

cut_tubes.source: ISO 2768-1 m column (https://amesweb.info/fits-tolerances/iso-2768-linear-dimensions-tolerances.aspx, checked 2026-10-21); squareness EST

general_tolerances.torque_method: No torque driver on hand: hang a known mass from a hex key, T = m g L (e.g. 0.6 N*m = 1.02 kg at L 60 mm). Makerspace torque driver is an assumption.
